paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County farmers planning to attend Mississippi State’s Row Crop Short Course can still sign up free Tuesday, Nov. 24. The university asks growers to register before Nov. 25 for the free rate. Later registration, including at the door, costs $40. Either rate includes three lunches and two evening meals.

The course runs Dec. 7–9 at The Mill, 600 Russell St. in Starkville. Specialists will cover weed control, crop disease, insects and soil fertility. Farmers can use the Extension registration portal linked below or call Mary-Margaret Fancher at 662-325-2311 with questions.

For local questions, the Pontotoc County Extension office lists Steven Tucker as an agriculture and natural resources agent. The office is at 402 C.J. Hardin Jr. Drive in Pontotoc and can be reached at 662-489-3910.

The forest taxation webinar runs from noon to 1 p.m. Central on Tuesday, Dec. 1. Yanshu Li of the University of Georgia will discuss timber taxes, casualty losses, conservation easements and income from carbon credits. The webinar has its own registration form.
